start: Profile > Exercises > New exercise, name and muscle filled

user_sees: Sheet 'Add your photo or video' with 'It stays on this phone. A video can be up to 30 seconds, and it plays without sound when you tap the exercise's picture.'
Rows 'Choose from your gallery', 'Take a photo', 'Record a video', 'Cancel'
must_not: The sheet promising a backup of the file

steps.action: Tap 'Choose from your gallery', pick a photo of the gym's machine
user_sees: 'Adding your photo or video…' then the photo in the card with 'Change' and 'Remove'
must_not: The photo lost if it is later deleted from the gallery

user_sees: The member's photo as the exercise's picture with 'Tap to see your photo'
must_not: 'Tap to watch the movement' on a still photo

start: A library exercise the member never logged, its page open

steps.action: Open the options menu, tap 'Your photo or video'
user_sees: Screen titled 'Your photo or video' with 'A photo of your gym's machine helps you find it. It shows instead of our picture.'
must_not: The library exercise's name or muscles made editable

steps.action: Tap 'Record a video', record 10 seconds, save
user_sees: The exercise page plays the clip without sound when the picture is tapped

start: New exercise form, Add photo or video sheet open

steps.action: Tap 'Choose from your gallery', pick a 2-minute video
user_sees: 'Could not add it' with 'Pick a video of 30 seconds or less — one or two reps is plenty.'
must_not: The 2-minute film copied whole into the app

user_sees: 'Could not add it' with 'That video is too large. Pick a shorter one.'
must_not: The app freezing while it copies

steps.action: Refuse the camera permission, tap 'Take a photo'
user_sees: 'Could not add it' with 'MettleUp needs the camera for this. You can allow it in your phone settings, or choose from your gallery.'
must_not: The permission prompt on every tap with no way on

start: An own exercise with a photo

steps.action: Edit it, tap 'Change', pick another photo, tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: The new photo on the exercise page
must_not: The old file left behind taking space

user_sees: The plain mark or library drawing in its place

steps.action: Pick a photo then close the form without saving

The photo said to be backed up
